heard: Seven Earth-sized planets are crammed inside the orbit of Mercury. They circle a red dwarf barely larger than the planet Jupiter. On the world Trappist 1e, one here lasts just six days. It's these permanently locked with one side always facing its sun. One half is scorched desert, the other is frozen night. This rapid orbit through stellar winds creates massive electric currents. These currents act like a heater potentially stripping the atmosphere. It is a world caught between paradise and airless rock. A whole solar system still huddles around this tiny red star.
differences: 'stays' heard as 'is these' after '6 days it'
